newsitem.title: USA: United States Filter buys Waterpro.
newsitem.headline: United States Filter buys Waterpro.

text.p: United States Filter Corporation said Wednesday it agreed to buy the WaterPro Supplies Corporation for approximately $95 million in stock.
WaterPro had revenues of approximately $300 million in 1995, up from $223 million in 1994 and $190 million in 1993.
It is the largest national distributor of water and wastewater products for municipal water authorities, with 43 offices in the Midwest, Mountain and Mid-Atlantic regions.

U.S. Filter, based in Palm Desert, Calif., is a global provider of industrial and municipal water and wastewater treatment systems, products and services, with annual revenues of over $900 million. It has 170 sales and service offices worldwide.
The company said it expects the aquisition to increase its earnings this fiscal year.
U.S. Filter's stock was down 12.5 cents at $26.62 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
